value.rationale: The reentrant interval of entirely real decay modes is an exact non-obvious physical regime, with a unique accessible third-order exceptional cusp and cubic-root sensitivity. The strict no-work-revival result at this singularity distinguishes spectral degeneracy from operational coherent-energy backflow for every bath preparation. It is a natural complete classification of memory and coupling parameters, not a chosen arbitrary numerical slice. Limitations include no all-parameter backflow map and no independent microscopic CP proof.
